scope: Finite source reconciliation map for the193 previously enumerated divergent commits (including primary149), with dispositions for every237 original test name. Current automatic/supplemental contracts, replacements and exclusions remain distinct. No whole-game correctness, natural attainment, physical-device or launch clearance claim.

resolution.reason: The Seer/Cartographer offer-intent and bounded fieldwork policies are not registered in the four-policy release controller. Preserve the existing shared/NPC brain and reactor choices. Current personal discovery/sharing mechanics are retained; do not claim these absent named strategies establish natural Explorer viability.

The absent explorer-intent makePolicy opening hook is a strategy experiment. Native fresh opening really answers the shown knack and starts a run; that is separate from whether this old named controller answers it. No policy-equivalence claim.

Current ordinary23-metric comparison rejects changed harnesses/controllers/horizons/flags and invalid observations. The old declaration-enabled cross-harness and cross-policy modules are absent; do not restore them as a game-only gate. Explicit maintenance bridges remain separately labelled, with actual state/metric equality.

Missing original optional policy/observer helper, not a loaded Game boot path. Preserve historical evidence; current shared23-metric collector/contracts/neutrality are authoritative. No broad simulation rewrite in this milestone.

campaign-quartermaster/preparer/rations are absent optional controller cohorts. The player counter shell/pickup, paid food transfer and whole-stack capacity flows are retained and tested, but these do not prove the absent army provisioning strategy or twenty-person natural funding. No new strategy cohort or broad bot rewrite during release freeze.

Missing original optional policy/observer helper, not a loaded Game boot path. Preserve historical evidence; current shared23-metric collector/contracts/neutrality are authoritative. No broad simulation rewrite in this milestone.

The old opt-in ration-retention callback and contribution-aware army pantry policy are not current controller APIs. Actual stock, capacity and donor/recipient payment guards remain. Do not infer daily strategy reserve/return behavior from the player transfer proofs.

The separate campaign-audit/campaign-scorecard compound instrumenter is absent. Current balanced collector, strict source identities, neutral controls, exact case hashes and all23 metrics are authoritative. No campaign-specific stall/opportunity coverage is claimed or synthesized from generic panels.

The old day151 extension auditor is absent. Current panels keep their declared150-day horizon; no absence of a within-horizon invitation is reinterpreted as proof that later invitation is impossible. Public Table entry/scene ownership and actual endings are independently retained; no historical extension result is relabelled current.

The old separately named strategy-pair scorecard is absent. Current standard comparison keeps fixed controllers/policies across each Game comparison and all23 per-policy metrics. Do not compare differently named strategies as if only Game changed; named-policy experimentation remains outside this release milestone.

The optional voice-preparation/livelihood controller is absent. Current paid player/NPC God verbs remain functional, but no extraordinary trust-band, same-day pre-encounter or reserve-preserving bot preparation behavior is inferred. Keep natural ability-use opportunity distinct from possession.

Dealer/Hoarder offer-intent callbacks are absent strategy experiments. Retain current shared build choice and actual paid Haggle/Market mechanics. No special preferred-offer or full-slot reactor-retention strategy claim is made for the absent callback.

All33 literal historical assertions explicitly mapped to current survival-parity44; dynamic wild/contest survivors preserved with an honest sealed finishing kill and original hopeless later death. Current API/payment/receipt semantics replace obsolete fixture/API assumptions. See release-sealed-survival-mapping-r1.json and test-field-health-outcome.

resolution.scope: Historical partial-module fixture:500kcal cannot erase80 hunger (2000kcal), and the examined key hardcodes3,3 while current Haven is4,4. These two assertions are superseded, not passing.

resolution.reason: Primary8b265c63df reorders Second Wind from its existing later Strange-kit position into the initial six-entry offer window. Current deterministic three-choice API remains; the old test demands a different no-prior-magic availability lever. Defer this balance/access experiment under the bounded release freeze, without claiming natural Undying viability.

deed-screen sourceHead supplied-archive/branch API is absent. Current sourceHead reports only a real checkout identity and leaves nested archives unknown; immutable source manifests, explicit archive commit metadata and cache fingerprints are retained. Do not fabricate a commit identity for an archive without one.

The proposed public-prompt meter parser is absent. Current CAPABLE_READ_STAKES remains an explicit opt-in using supplied state and is not claimed to mimic only visible phone information; keep it default-OFF and source-pinned. Native Table choices/failed doors are tested separately. No policy information-fairness claim is inferred.

resolution.scope: Current supplementary contract outside automatic list; successful exit is retained separately.

resolution.reason: peer-league automation is absent. Existing human equal-link/trade/food/favor mechanics remain; no natural peer-only strategy viability, village proposal cadence or response policy is claimed. Default four-policy panels are mixed policies, not pacifist/peer proof.

Current test-ammo-upgrade-policy retains ordinary funded recipe/crafting/equipment/real-shot assertions and guards unknown recipes, live fights, zero-unit and stronger weapons; it also retains explicit optional bank behavior without changing default gameplay.

All14 original assertions pass unchanged with only imports relocated. This proves actual nested contest/fan rewards counted once, recipe/material/craft census, harmless dashboard import, hash version/normalization and exact100-day observer-off equality. The restored shared-kit proof now runs automatically.

The proposed dashboard split classifies a person as hostile solely because the bearer killed them; that does not establish affiliation and can misclassify a murdered resident. It also treats every older unknown person death as a villager. Do not restore those assumptions. Current legacy dashboard Other includes unclassified person deaths and is not a total-NPC-casualty measure; balanced known-living-NPC coverage and raw death kinds are authoritative. This reporting limitation remains explicit, not a passing old test.

cookHaul/treatSick/learn/detect and old daily God-hook assumptions are not equivalent current controller APIs. Actual cooking, paid care, lessons, evidence and God verbs have their own runtime/native proofs; these cannot establish the absent bot habits. No silent restoration or claimed equivalence of policy counters.
